senses.definition: (sometimes figurative) To move from one place to another; to redistribute.
senses.example: We'll have to shift these boxes to the downtown office.

senses.definition: A change of workers, now specifically a set group of workers or period of working time.
senses.example: We'll work three shifts a day till the job's done.
